info.name: Get total and unlocked STX supply

params.name: height
params.description: Supply details are queried from specified block height. If the block height is not specified, the latest block height is taken as default value. Note that the `block height` is referred to the stacks blockchain.

params.name: unanchored
params.description: Include data from unanchored (i.e. unconfirmed) microblocks

info.name: Get the network target block time

items.docs: Retrieves the target block times for mainnet and testnet. The block time is hardcoded and will change throughout the implementation phases of the testnet.

info.name: Get a given network's target block time

items.docs: Retrieves the target block time for a given network. The network can be mainnet or testnet. The block time is hardcoded and will change throughout the implementation phases of the testnet.

info.name: Query the health of the node.

items.docs:
Get node health information.
A node is considered healthy if its Stacks tip height matches the maximum Stacks tip height observed among its connected peers.
This endpoint returns:
- `difference_from_max_peer`: The difference in Stacks height between this node and its most advanced peer.
- `max_stacks_height_of_neighbors`: The maximum Stacks height observed among the node"s connected peers.
- `node_stacks_tip_height`: The current Stacks tip height of this node.

Get information about the node"s neighbor peers in the network.
